modelOverview: The Tank Solo is Cartier's entry-level take on the archetypal Tank silhouette first drawn in 1917, stripped of the Louis Cartier line's dressier finishing in favour of a simpler, more contemporary read on the rectangular case. The XL (Extra-Large) size is the largest Tank Solo model and, since around 2015, has been fitted with Cartier's in-house automatic Calibre 1847 MC rather than an outsourced ETA movement.

W5200028.movement: Automatic · Cartier Calibre 1847 MC · 28,800 vph · 40h power reserve
W5200028.dial: Silvered opaline dial with blued-steel sword-shaped hands, Roman numeral hour markers and a railway minute track; date aperture at 6 o'clock
W5200028.description: The Tank Solo XL is the largest execution of Cartier's pared-back Tank line, pairing the house's signature rectangular Art Deco case with a clean silvered dial and blued sword hands. Since around 2015 it has run on Cartier's own automatic Calibre 1847 MC, giving it in-house credentials at an accessible entry point to the Tank family. This piece is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.
